# Overview
{: .no_toc }

Is production healthy right now, and is anything costing or failing?
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `OPS-01` |
| **Route** | `/ops` |
| **Where** | Operations › Overview |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view (superadmin until G10) |
| **Kind** | detail |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M3 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Health | StatusBadge | `GET /health` | Down → banner linking OPS-04 |
| Alarms | summary chips | firing / OK counts | any firing → sidebar badge on Operations |
| Traffic tiles | metric tiles | requests, 4xx rate, 5xx rate, p95 latency, Lambda errors and throttles, Aurora ACU, webhook DLQ depth | each tile → OPS-02 at that metric |
| Cost | progress bar | month-to-date vs warn and hard budgets | → OPS-07 |
| Recent security events | list | → SEC-01 | 5 newest |
| Recent admin activity | list | `GET /audit-events` | → AUD-01 |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: per tile, so one failing source doesn't blank the page; Gateway `403` → "Operations needs the operations.view permission."

## For developers

Loads: `GET /health` (API) · `GET /ops/metrics?panel=overview&range=1h` · `GET /ops/alarms` · `GET /ops/cost` · `GET /audit-events?limit=10`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
